text:
Type: embroidered floral cushion
Use: comfort and decoration on a sofa, an armchair or a bed; living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, traditional, farmhouse
Materials: cotton fabric with dense colored embroidery
Colors: light grey, coral red, dusty pink, sage green, grey, beige
Shape: rectangular plump cushion with scattered embroidered flowers, berries and leafy stems in a loose folk pattern, soft rounded edges
Feel: charming, soft, romantic, homey
Goes with: white or grey sofas, light wood, pastel and red accents; Scandinavian, farmhouse or cottage-style rooms

product.name: HEDBLOMSTER
product.description: Embroidery adds texture and lustre to the cushion.
